Number-Conversion Macros / Format Conversions

ColorToFract

You can use the ColorToFract macro to convert a gxColorValue number to a fract number. 
#define ColorToFract(a) (((fract)(a)<<14) + ((fract)(a) +2 >>2))
a
A gxColorValue number to be converted to a fract number.
macro result
A fract number having the same value as the gxColorValue number.
